items.quote: for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD
items.claim: On a specific day, God smote all the firstborn in Egypt and hallowed all the firstborn in Israel
items.object: all the firstborn in the land of Egypt; all the firstborn in Israel; both man and beast
